name: Hype caption
caption_prompt:
Write one short on-screen hook for a 10–15s DJ drop reaction clip.

Style:
- Sound like a hyped fan in the comments, not a brand
- 3–8 words max, lowercase is fine
- Punchy reaction energy like "this transition is crazy" / "the drop just hit" / "nobody was ready"
- No hashtags, no emojis, no quotes

Use the set vibe from {title} and the fan energy from {comment}.
If nearby reactions help, pull from {comments} — don't list them.

Output ONLY the hook line.
